shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && rg -n "lastUsage|afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata|receives collected response text and usage" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/types/ai.ts && cat .lore/test-commands.yml'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; sed -n '1,130p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '220,275p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:|@spec|SPEC\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -60; rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g '*Usage*' -g '*lore*' src scripts .lore | head -80; sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,115p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '460,575p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#([0-9]+)|@spec|spec-anchor|validated by:'"' src/*.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100; rg -n 'tests_covering|lore-query-trace|lore_query_trace' .lore scripts 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls -la .lore; git log -1 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,210p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,160p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; sed -n '1,160p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs; rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#[0-9]+'"' src scripts | head -60"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'anchor|specs/.*#[0-9]|tests.list|spec field' AGENTS.md .lore/test-commands.yml scripts | head -80; sed -n '145,210p' AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,60p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts | head -12 && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '42,46p' && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md && git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTotalUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "Sum provider usage across tool rounds" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
